decision_note: Floral methoxypyrazines are discussed as cues for pollinators and florivores; the focal bioassay tests florivorous scarabs, so retain as a cue-sharing near-pass candidate.
Delphinium study experimentally links nectar-robbing damage to staminode mechanics, pollinator visitation and pollen transfer/reproductive function; retain.
Apocynaceae pollinator-screening methods record floral visitors including exploitative/robbing visitor categories; uncertainty at TA stage resolves to retention.
Deceptive Doritis pollination study concerns alternative mechanisms promoting cross-pollination; the apparent antagonism is not a plant antagonist/exploiter audience.
Cyclopogon floral scent paper explicitly discusses florivores whose activities can result in pollination and a simple DMNT floral coordinate; retain under TA uncertainty.
Jaltomata floral-evolution paper uses antagonistic pleiotropy/genetic constraint terminology; no plant antagonist audience is evaluated.
Preprint of the Jaltomata floral-evolution study; no plant antagonist audience is evaluated, independently of later duplicate handling.
Cassia stamen manipulation directly tests the conflict between pollen consumption by bees and pollen used for fertilization; retain as a within-pollinator exploitation/display-division candidate.
Peach JAZ study manipulates floral display/autogamy and stress signaling but does not measure an animal pollinator response or service component.
Agricultural soil legacy study jointly evaluates floral rewards/traits, pollinators, herbivores/pathogens and multitrophic interactions; retain.
Native tobacco update synthesizes ecological costs, herbivore-induced defenses, floral nicotine/benzylacetone and pollinator context; retain as secondary/source-role material.
Review of floral volatile terpenoids covers ecological signaling functions and is relevant to source recovery; retain for later review-only adjudication.
Ant-guard experiment measures pollinator behavior and defensive-mutualist context at flowers; retain, with focal-coordinate admissibility deferred to full text.
Turnera ant-pollinator dissertation explicitly addresses ecological costs/evolutionary consequences of defensive ant-plant interactions for pollination; retain.
Impatiens dissertation concerns antagonists, mixed mating and chasmogamous reproduction; retain for evolutionary/full-text adjudication under TA uncertainty.
Disa visual-cue manipulation shows the same pollen-feeding beetle chews petal apices and pollinates; color manipulation changes pollination success and florivory covaries with pollen transfer.
White-clover common garden quantifies antiherbivore defense, herbivory and selection on floral/reproductive traits; retain for evolutionary conflict adjudication.
Agroecological-crop study explicitly observes ants as legitimate floral visitors or nectar thieves and assesses pollen loads/germination effects; retain as role-switching visitor candidate.

Arctic mustard color-polymorphism study resolves the genetic basis of a floral display whose geographic maintenance has documented pollinator and non-pollinator selection context; retain for evolutionary-outcome linkage.
Ideas/Perspectives article concerns deceptive plants exploiting their pollinators; the exploited party is the pollinator, not a plant antagonist/exploiter audience acting on the floral signal.
Mixed-ploidy orchid study evaluates floral signals, reproductive success and pollinator isolation; no focal antagonist/exploiter channel is measured.
Review/synthesis links floral traits and visitor behavior to plant and animal pathogen transmission; retain as potentially relevant antagonist/source-registry material.
Platanthera study describes floral-trait variation across elevation; no focal antagonist/exploiter response is evaluated.
Rafflesia volatile study characterizes scent proposed to attract carrion-fly pollinators; 'parasitic' describes the plant life history and is not an antagonist audience acting on the flower.
Trollius-Chiastocheta nursery-pollination system explicitly combines adult pollination with larval seed/fruit costs and examines mutualism-antagonism asymmetry; retain.
2026 review is explicitly pollinator-friendly crop breeding/plant-pollinator synthesis; herbivory appears as trade-off background rather than a focal antagonist audience.
Coffee-agroecosystem dissertation contains primary chapters on habitat-dependent nectar robbery, floral traits and fruit-set costs alongside mutualistic bee-plant interactions; retain.

Eight-generation Brassica experimental evolution factorially crosses soil, bee pollination and aphid herbivory and measures floral/defense evolution and bee attractiveness; strong evolutionary-outcome candidate.
Blueberry floral morphology predicts legitimate bee visits versus nectar robbing by honey bees and is related to crop yield; retain as direct role-dependent floral-trait case.
Book chapter synthesizes experimental manipulations of floral scent and animal behavioral responses; retain for source-role review and possible antagonist examples.
Dissertation on competitive pollination networks covers heterogeneous floral visitors/foraging strategies; retain under TA uncertainty for exploiter/competition coding.
Concepts & Synthesis paper develops empirical benefit/cost curves for pollination mutualisms, including costly/seed-consuming pollinator systems; retain as relevant synthesis.
Coffee-agroforestry dissertation covers bees, wasps, parasitoids and ecosystem services across land-use contexts; retain under TA uncertainty for source/geography adjudication.
Floral-scent biochemistry review is relevant source-registry material for ecological scent functions; retain for later review-only adjudication.
Rose 2-phenylethanol review focuses biosynthesis/seasonal regulation; pollinator attraction and herbivore defense are general background rather than a focal dual-audience study.
